title: Template: Next.js Browser Runtime Regression Debugging
goal: Investigate and fix a real Next.js storefront runtime regression by reproducing browser-only symptoms, stabilizing linked review entry behavior, deferring advanced compare code until requested, and stopping repeated interactions from accumulating runtime handlers while preserving the real downstream catalog inputs.
skillBenefitRationale: The debugging category benefits directly because the task withholds explicit incident artifacts and requires a browser-first workflow: reproduce symptoms in a live browser, measure stability and code-loading behavior, implement a root-cause fix, and defend against shortcuts that bypass the real runtime bottlenecks.
